SELECT R.ORG_MSTR_CODE AS regionCode, R.ORG_CODE AS districtCode, NULLIF(R.STAGE_CODE, '') AS stage, CASE WHEN R.DATE_UNKNOWN_IND = 'N' THEN DATE_FORMAT(R.FOUND_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') END AS day, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN R.STATUS_CODE = 'dropped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dropped FROM TGMSTR R WHERE R.LIB_ID = #{libId} AND R.DEL_IND = 'N'
GROUP BY R.ORG_MSTR_CODE, R.ORG_CODE, R.STAGE_CODE, day

SELECT R.ORG_MSTR_CODE AS regionCode, R.ORG_CODE AS districtCode, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(R.ACT_MINUTES) AS minutes FROM ACTMSTR R WHERE R.LIB_ID = #{libId} AND R.DEL_IND = 'N' AND R.ACT_DATE >= #{f.from} AND R.ACT_DATE <= #{f.to}
GROUP BY R.ORG_MSTR_CODE, R.ORG_CODE

SELECT R.ORG_MSTR_CODE AS regionCode, R.ORG_CODE AS districtCode,
COALESCE(CONCAT('id:', NULLIF(R.EMPL_ID, '')), CONCAT('code:', NULLIF(R.INTRO_EMPL_CODE, '')), CONCAT('name:', NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(R.INTRO_NAME, ''), R.WORKER_NAME)), '')), '') AS groupKey, MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(R.INTRO_NAME, ''), R.WORKER_NAME)), '')) AS itemName,
COALESCE(R.BAN_CODE, '') AS groupKey, '' AS groupKey,
SUM(CASE WHEN R.FOUND_DATE AND R.DATE_UNKNOWN_IND = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS findings, SUM(CASE WHEN R.MANPIK_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS manpik, SUM(CASE WHEN R.FIND_A_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS findA, SUM(CASE WHEN R.HAB_B_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS habB, SUM(CASE WHEN R.HAB_A_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS habA, SUM(CASE WHEN R.YOUNG_TTA_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS youngTta, SUM(CASE WHEN R.BOKSHIN_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bokshin, SUM(CASE WHEN R.CARD_RECEIVED_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cardReceived, SUM(CASE WHEN R.CENTER_REGISTERED_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS centerRegistered FROM TGMSTR R WHERE R.LIB_ID = #{libId} AND R.DEL_IND = 'N' AND (R.FOUND_DATE OR R.MANPIK_DATE OR R.FIND_A_DATE OR R.HAB_B_DATE OR R.HAB_A_DATE OR R.YOUNG_TTA_DATE OR R.BOKSHIN_DATE OR R.CARD_RECEIVED_DATE OR R.CENTER_REGISTERED_DATE )

SELECT R.ORG_MSTR_CODE AS regionCode, R.ORG_CODE AS districtCode,
COALESCE(CONCAT('id:', NULLIF(R.EMPL_ID, '')), CONCAT('code:', NULLIF(R.EMPL_CODE, '')), CONCAT('name:', NULLIF(TRIM(R.EMPL_NAME), '')), '') AS groupKey, MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(R.EMPL_NAME), '')) AS itemName,
COALESCE(R.BAN_CODE, '') AS groupKey, '' AS groupKey,
COUNT(*) AS activities, SUM(R.ACT_MINUTES) AS minutes FROM ACTMSTR R WHERE R.LIB_ID = #{libId} AND R.DEL_IND = 'N' AND R.ACT_DATE
